root.label: FLA and JNIM align against Malian government

slots.name: FLA JNIM alignment status
slots.sentence: While the FLA presents itself as a secular nationalist movement seeking independence for Mali’s Azawad region and JNIM is an al-Qaeda-affiliated group, the two sides have set ideological differences aside to confront the Malian government.
